chunks: Whoever fears for himself from grief due to a calamity, then let him pour forth some of his tears, for it calms it from him.

key_terms.نَفْسِهِ: his own self or inner state

ai.seo_question: How does Islam view crying after a calamity?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that expressing grief through tears can bring emotional relief after a calamity. The hadith presents weeping as a natural means of easing the intensity of sorrow.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.568 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever fears being overwhelmed by grief due to a calamity should let their tears flow, for it will bring them relief."
